code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Get station 14 coordinate and find nearest DECLARED_MONUMENT
query = text("""
SELECT 
    sa.name,
    ST_Distance(
        sa.geometry::geography,
        (SELECT coordinate::geography FROM air_quality_station WHERE id = 14)
    ) as distance_m
FROM sensitive_area sa
WHERE sa.category = 'DECLARED_MONUMENT'
ORDER BY distance_m
LIMIT 1
""")

result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)
